finding: A retained source-bound promotion artifact requires fresh semantic reassessment in addition to byte binding; otherwise exact source provenance can remain valid while gate behavior or retained assessment content drifts.

verification.method: node --test against an isolated reconstruction of the committed core contract
cases: accept exact source bytes and semantically identical reassessment
reject same-length source mutation by SHA-256

uncertainty: The full CLI was not executed against authenticated retained workflow-enumeration evidence in this run.
falsification_route: Run the CLI against a real schema-v2 promotion artifact and its exact retained source, then mutate either source bytes or the gate implementation and require verification to fail.
privacy_boundary: Contains repository paths, abstract evidence classifications, and test outcomes only; no credentials, private workflow payloads, chat content, or personal data.
